headline: Visual Designer & Social Media Creative
tagline: Graphic designer with proven experience driving social engagement and managing digital campaigns.

skills.label: Core Competencies

Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Managed print-ready file preparation including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders to maintain low revision cycles.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer

Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.
Conducted usability testing and applied findings to user flows and interface usability.

Delivered cohesive visual assets aligned with brand identity.
